decision: ADR-020 §3 (scheduler decision 2026-10-09): Action definitions NexLoop itself needs are published at deployment through trusted configuration (0050), compiled from this versioned declaration; never constructed ad hoc and never written to definition tables directly.

actions.purpose: Create the Message object of an Agent reply after the channel accepted it (NX-047); content, sender, conversation and delivery state come from the governed outbound record, never from the caller.
